body:
maya: FYI — saw a small but noisy set of streaming resumes where provisional tokens never moved to confirmed. Customers noticed transient "provisional spike" in console and pinged CS.
ryan: can you paste a minimal repro?
maya: sample: request=xy77 route=eu-fallback started_on=primary-us resume_on=eu-fallback cause=kv-evict toolcall_attached=true
maya: snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-12T09:42:01Z req=xy77 event=resume provisional=18 confirmed=null last_ack_offset=120 toolcall_suffix_present=true
```
leif: suspicion: when a toolcall is appended mid-stream, our resume path currently drops the suffix metadata. That means the ledger writes a provisional row for the resumed tokens but never sees the toolcall final ack to flip confirmed.
zara: UX: console turns provisional->confirmed after final ack. If final ack never reaches accounting, the UI shows an inflated provisional count for hours. Not great.
billing-bot: alert: provisional_overage_eu 2026-03-12T09:42 +0.12% vs baseline
ryan: two separate problems: (1) missing suffix metadata on resume causing unreconciled provisional rows, (2) route attribution ambiguity — do we bill/quota to origin route or route where tokens were consumed?
maya: patch idea: stop dropping toolcall metadata on resume; persist suffix_id + suffix_token_count in the provisional row so any later final ack can be matched.
leif: alternative: add a reconciliation pass that uses request_id + last_ack_offset to compute delta and convert provisional->confirmed when gap is observed. Safer short-term.
zara: for the console, I can add a small "provisional" badge next to token usage with hover: "pending finalization; may change" and a link to the trace. Keep it collapsed by default.
ryan: on attribution: Ops and Billing disagree. Billing wants charge where tokens were consumed. Quota wants the original route so customers aren't surprised by quota evictions.
maya: pragmatic compromise: ledger rows get two columns: charge_route and quota_route. charge_route defaults to the final execution route; quota_route defaults to the route that accepted the request unless the router explicitly rewrites routing headers.
leif: implementationally that's simple: add charge_route and quota_route fields to proto and db row. Reconciler can backfill mismatches for recent days.
ryan: rollout: feature flag charge_route=final for 5% traffic, measure delta on invoices and quota burn. If delta > 0.5% or customer complaints spike, revert.
zara: I'll mock the hover copy and small FAQ blurb. Also show both routes in the detailed trace view, hide secondary on summary.
maya: I'll open INF-1160 with log samples, proposed schema change, and reconcile job plan. Assign to eng-platform + eng-sre.
leif: follow-up: SRE to schedule 15m reconciliation for resume events for first 24h of rollout. If we see spikes in provisional>confirmed, expand automatic reconcile window.
ryan: add dashboard: provisional_ratio by route + flag cohort, and a list of top request_ids with unreconciled provisional tokens.
zara: UX OK — will wire trace link into dashboard.
maya: thanks — INF-1160 created, sample ids: xy77, mn12, pq34.
ryan: cool. quick patch + 5% canary sounds good. :thumbsup:
leif: I'll start the reconciler PR and proto changes.
maya: if anyone hits customers complaining, escalate to oncall and we'll pause flag.
zara: added FAQ blurb to the ticket.
